o: Can you bring me a glass of water?
Can you take me a glass of water?
fix.why: Bring = toward me or the listener. Take = away from here.

cloze.q: Yesterday my sister ___ her laptop to class.
cloze.ar: البارح أختي جابت الحاسوب ديالها للقسم.

o: Almost everyone came to the party.
Almost of the people came to the party.
fix.why: Almost goes directly before the word, with no "of".

cloze.q: I ___ missed the bus this morning.
cloze.ar: شوية وكنت نفوت الطوبيس هاد الصباح.

o: We had fun at the park.
We made fun at the park.
fix.why: Have fun = enjoy yourself. Make fun of = laugh at someone.

o: The keys are behind the sofa.
The keys are behind of the sofa.

cloze.q: Our team is ___ schedule on this project.
cloze.ar: الفريق ديالنا متأخر على الوقت المحدد ف هاد المشروع.

o: They moved to Marrakech last year.
They moved in Marrakech last year.
fix.why: Use "to" for the new place: move to.

cloze.q: I want to ___ to a bigger apartment.

o: I found it difficult to understand him.
I found difficult to understand him.
fix.why: You need "it" after find in this pattern.

cloze.q: I looked everywhere but I couldn't ___ my glasses.
cloze.ar: قلبت فكل بلاصة ولكن ما قدرتش نلقى النظارات ديالي.

o: Many people are waiting outside.
Many people is waiting outside.
fix.why: People is already plural: people are.

cloze.q: A lot of ___ come to this market on Sundays.
cloze.ar: بزاف د الناس كيجيو لهاد السوق نهار الأحد.

o: I made a mistake in the bill.
I did a mistake in the bill.
fix.why: English uses make with mistake, not do.

cloze.ar: ما تقلقش، الكل كيغلط من وقت لآخر.

o: I began learning English last year.
I began learn English last year.
fix.why: Begin + to learn / learning, never begin + bare verb.

o: Let's wait outside.
Let's wait at outside.
fix.why: Outside needs no preposition before it.
